dedupe_keys.name: shake table test of the nheri tallwood 10 story mass timber building with post tensioned rocking walls and supplemental uplift friction dampers

description: Shake Table Test of the NHERI TallWood 10-story Mass Timber Building with Post-tensioned Rocking Walls and Supplemental Uplift Friction Dampers is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Daniel Dowden, Michigan Technological University (mtu.edu). In this experimental study, the dynamic response of a recently introduced low-damage Uplift Friction Damper (UFD) for post-tensioned rocking mass timber walls (PT-RMTWs) was investigated. The objective of these tests was to validate the performance of the proposed UFDs subjected to simulated dynamic earthquake loads installed on rocking walls with realistic boundary conditions. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: shake table test,  mass timber,  post-tensioned rocking wall, friction dampers. Published 2024-10-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
